description: 静岡市公共施設情報 [evacuation shelters and public facilities] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 静岡市. ＜令和8年9月9日更新＞ ※「静岡市アセットマネジメント【公共建築物施設群別マネジメント方針】」において対象としている施設の情報 ※掲載項目及び使用コードは、総務省で定めた推奨フォーマットに準拠. Coverage: 静岡市. The portal files it under the publisher 静岡市. Its tags are 公共施設. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-09-09 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
